basic_info.description: Welcome to Bayview Heights, a tranquil retreat located on the charming cul-de-sac of Le Conte Ave. This beautifully renovated home has undergone over $50,000 in significant upgrades to ensure exceptional quality for modern living.  The spacious open-concept floor plan is both inviting and functional, featuring new hardwood flooring throughout. As you enter, you'll be greeted by a bright living and dining area, complete with a cozy fireplace and a family room. The newly added kitchen boasts all-new stainless steel appliances, making it a delight for any home chef.    Step out onto the stunning decks and take in the breathtaking 180-degree views of San Francisco. On the second floor, you'll find a large skylight and three bedrooms, including a magnificent master suite with its own private deck. The master bathroom features a skylight, allowing for an abundance of natural light, while an additional updated full bathroom in the hallway adds convenience for family and guests.    The lower level includes a spacious two-car garage, as well as a versatile bonus room that is ideal for a home office or an extra bedroom. Enjoy your private large yard, complete with built-in benches that are perfect for entertaining in the afternoon sun.
